generic.returnSummary: Items returned incomplete, damaged, stained or in a condition preventing resale may be refused or refunded partially.
generic.returnTransport: The customer bears the risk of loss or damage during return shipping for a change of mind or a non-defective item. We therefore recommend tracked shipping and keeping proof of posting.

shoes.returnSummary: Items returned incomplete, damaged, stained, worn outdoors, with marked soles, excessive creases or in a condition preventing resale may be refused or refunded partially.

phrases.returnAddress: Return items to the following address after your request is approved by email: {{returnAddress}}.
phrases.returnAddressPending: Return items to the address we will provide by email after approving your return request.
phrases.returnFeesShop: For returns due to a change of mind, incorrect choice, variant or personal preference, return costs are paid by {{storeName}}.
phrases.returnFeesClient: For returns due to a change of mind, incorrect choice, variant or personal preference, return costs are paid by the customer.
phrases.returnLabelShop: In this case, {{storeName}} provides a prepaid return label after approving the request. Follow the instructions sent by our customer service team.
phrases.returnLabelClient: In this case, {{storeName}} does not prepay the return label. The customer is responsible for downloading, printing and buying a return label from their chosen carrier.
phrases.exchangeFeesShop: Return costs for an exchange for personal convenience are paid by {{storeName}}.
phrases.exchangeFeesClient: Return costs for an exchange for personal convenience are paid by the customer.
phrases.shippingFree: Shipping is free on all orders delivered to the following area: {{shippingCountry}}.
phrases.shippingPaid: Shipping costs {{shippingFee}} for orders delivered to the following area: {{shippingCountry}}.
